capabilities._note: Image edit with one reference image (ReferenceLatent on the prompt); with none it is text to image. A keyframe gets its first character's picked view (else the plate).

template._note: Sizes a series ref is generated at (as krea2's). A keyframe is generated at its shot's render size, scaled up (same aspect, multiples of size_multiple) to at least min_pixels: the video targets scale a keyframe to the frame anyway, and Kontext draws poorly far below its 1 MP training size. The reference is scaled by FluxKontextImageScale, as the template does.

recipe._note: One reference, named 'the image' in the prompt (targets/image/common.py reference_intro).

binding._note: An API graph built from the user's saved flux_kontext_image_base.json, trimmed to the branch its SaveImage reads (the canvas holds six more samplers and image stitches): UNETLoader + DualCLIPLoader (clip_l, t5xxl, flux) + the ae VAE; the reference: LoadImage -> FluxKontextImageScale -> VAEEncode -> ReferenceLatent on the prompt, titled 'Reference 1 ...' (cut out with no reference); FluxGuidance; KSampler 20 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple on an EmptySD3LatentImage at the job's size. Guidance 2.5 is ComfyUI's Kontext template's (flux_kontext_dev_basic.json) and the canvas' other branches'; the saved branch had 1.5 for a style transfer. H3SaveRefTake takes the place of SaveImage.

models._note: Families from the installed files' headers (targets/modelid.py): Kontext dev has FLUX.1 dev's tensors (the header says FLUX.1 dev; the name says Kontext). All required.

presets._note: ComfyUI's Kontext dev template (flux_kontext_dev_basic.json): its fp8 model, 20 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple, guidance 2.5; the text encoders are the user's saved workflow's (t5xxl_fp16; the template's t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled isn't installed). The saved workflow's flux1-kontext-dev.safetensors (full precision, installed) stands in by family. At cfg 1 the negative prompt has no effect.

downloads._note: URLs from ComfyUI's Kontext template (properties.models) and ComfyUI-Manager's model list.

flux1-kontext-dev.safetensors.source: no URL: no ComfyUI template, saved workflow or ComfyUI-Manager model list on this machine records this file (the fp8 file above stands in for it by family). Search Hugging Face for its exact name (black-forest-labs FLUX.1 Kontext dev, gated).
